changelog: Hand Grab Cursor (IDC_HAND): Intuitive hand cursor on mouse hover over the floating TopBar so you can effortlessly grab and move it anywhere
Instant Bengali Tooltips: Instant on-hover tooltips on all icons explaining their exact function in Bengali (On-Screen Keyboard, Translation, Word Manager, Settings, etc.)
Ultra-Fast Voice Typing: Real-time Voice Activity Detection (VAD) auto-stops recording after 600ms silence, streaming trimmed audio to Gemini for near-instant typing
Soft Modern Sky Blue / Azure Gradient: Aesthetic, eye-friendly palette replacing harsh colors
Dedicated 1-Click Translation Icon [🌐]: Seamless instant 1-click mode switching between Bangla, English, and Banglish->English translation
Horizontal Auto-Hide with Expand Arrow (>>): Keeps the 4 core controls permanently visible while secondary tools collapse into the bar
100% Offline-first local typing engine with zero telemetry
